serverInfo.name: m2m-sentinel
serverInfo.description: Deterministic EVM bytecode capability intelligence, EIP-1967 proxy resolution, gas recommendations, DEX token prices, liquidity telemetry, and whale signals for Base agents.

authentication.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits and paid tier access. Public free tier works without key.

tools.name: m2m_audit_contract
tools.description: Return selected static bytecode capability observations, common proxy resolution, limitations, and provenance for a Base contract.

tools.name: m2m_get_gas_metrics
tools.description: Return sourced Base gas fee metrics and execution recommendations.

tools.name: m2m_get_token_price
tools.description: Return sourced Base DEX token price observation for allowlisted assets (e.g. USDC, WETH).

tools.name: m2m_get_dex_liquidity
tools.description: Return tracked Base DEX pool reserve and liquidity metrics.

tools.name: m2m_get_whale_signals
tools.description: Return tracked Base whale transfer and concentration signals.

tools.name: m2m_get_service_status
tools.description: Return real-time operational status of M2M Sentinel upstream RPC and persistence rails.
